MATCHING & SORTING · 31 WORKSHEETS · AGE 2

Matching and sorting worksheets for 2-year-olds — printables.

Thirty-one matching and sorting worksheets from the owner’s own bold, friendly artwork: same-and-different pairs, animal twins and shadows, baby animals, big and small, color and shape sorts — every one a whole activity on a single page. Tap any picture to open it; download and print buttons live there.

SOLVE THEM ON SCREEN TOO

Every sheet has an on-screen twin.

Each of these thirty-one sheets can be solved right here on the website in Class 10 — Matching and Sorting (Age 2): the drawing layer sits on the picture, little hands draw the matching lines with a finger, a stylus or the mouse, and every child’s drawing is saved for next time. Open the class and start with Match Same Colors.
